episode_id.description: Research episode identifier. Public examples must use synthetic identifiers.

patient_id.description: Research patient identifier, if represented separately from episode_id.

infusion_timestamp.description: CAR T-cell infusion timestamp defining treatment-relative day 0.

therapy_label.description: Optional governed research label for therapy type; not required for the core trajectory model.

notes.description: Synthetic or governed research annotation. Identifying free text is prohibited in public examples.
